method: independent hand derivation; numeric decimal values also crosschecked by inline-probe-v1.py
rotation: For pair v=(a,b), R(theta)v=(a cos(theta)-b sin(theta),a sin(theta)+b cos(theta)). R(alpha)^T R(beta)=R(beta-alpha). With independent coordinate axes theta_i=omega_i*c_axis(i), the full dot product is the sum of per-pair dot products; only the assigned pair changes when one coordinate changes.
time_unit: t=time_ms/250, so (1250,1300,2300)ms -> (5,5.2,9.2). No quantization is performed. Each time pair has omega=pi/4 per 250ms.
score: Every content pair is (1,0). Height/width angles are zero for both Q and K, so each contributes 1. The time pair contributes cos((t_q-t_k)*pi/4). Therefore S=2+cos(delta_t*pi/4).
q_a: q_a time angle = 5.2*pi/4 = 1.3*pi, giving (-0.5877852522924731,-0.8090169943749475). Height and width pairs remain (1,0).
height_variation: h=1 adds angle pi/4 to the height pair only, producing (sqrt(1/2),sqrt(1/2)); first and third pairs remain q_a. w=1 instead changes the third pair only.
sequence_mapping: 0=video_begin; 1..16=F0..F15;17=video_end;18=audio_begin;19..22=A0..A3;23=audio_end. Hence F5=6, F15=16, A1=20. Mask M[i,j]=(i>=j) gives row20 true at j0..20 and false at21..23. F15 physical time is15*250=3750ms; sequence availability therefore is not physical-past availability.
index_only_counterfactual: Both shifted versions have exactly the same content, key index6 and query index20, so all rotation angles and dot products coincide. This demonstrates lack of shift information in that fixed representation, not an impossibility theorem for alternative input encodings.
periodicity: For this toy single speed, increasing relative physical time by8 units (2000ms) adds2*pi. S(delta=0)=3, S(delta=4)=1, S(delta=8)=3; increasing distance does not force monotonically lower scores. General RoPE has many per-pair frequencies and the content vectors also affect scores.
unit500: With t=time_ms/500, the three times become2.5,2.6,4.6. Their differences are0.1 and2.1; new scores are2+cos(pi/40)=2.996917333733128 and2+cos(21*pi/40)=1.921540904272155. With fixed pi/4 per time unit, halving t halves angular speed per millisecond.
scope: This is a deterministic rotation and mask demonstration. It performs no learning and establishes no audiovisual accuracy, spatial generalization, streaming causality, long-context performance or model quality.
